app.name: Profe Michi
app.tagline: Review vet anatomy with your voice

home.title: Study anatomy by answering out loud
home.subtitle: Upload your course material, answer by speaking, and get gentle feedback in minutes.
home.step1Body: Share the notes or guide you want to review.
home.step2Body: Explain each answer out loud, at your own pace.
home.step3Body: Profe Michi grades it and shares tips to improve.
home.futureBody: Login, profile, and quiz history are on the way.

upload.title: Upload your study material
upload.subtitle: We'll use your PDF to generate a 5-question quiz.
upload.questionCountNote: Right now every quiz has 5 questions. Choosing 5 or 10 is coming soon.
upload.invalidType: That file isn't a PDF. Try another one.

generating.title: Preparing your questions
generating.subtitle: Profe Michi is reading your material and building the quiz.
generating.aiNote: Questions are generated automatically from your material.

recorder.idleHint: Explain the answer in your own words, no rush.
recorder.recordingHint: Tap to stop when you're done.
recorder.readyHint: You can listen back or re-record.

grading.title: Grading your answers
grading.subtitle: Profe Michi is listening and evaluating each answer.
grading.note: This is a simulation: nothing is sent to a real server yet.

result.title: Quiz result
result.historySoon: Soon you'll be able to save and revisit your history here.
result.mascotCaption: Well done! Profe Michi is proud of you.
